prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1398; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute pain and swelling of the left wrist. Imaging confirmed a distal radius fracture, and examination findings were consistent with that diagnosis. The mechanism of injury, a lateral force transmitted through an outstretched hand, is in keeping with the type of fracture seen. Initial management consisted of immobilization and pain control, followed by a structured rehabilitation program. Over the course of 22 visits the patient progressed steadily, with decreasing pain, improving range of motion, and increasing grip strength. Visit frequency was reduced as recovery advanced, in line with the expected course for this injury. No prior injury or treatment to the same area is recorded in the patient's history. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service, with no duplicated entries. The patient has been discharged to independent home exercise with follow-up as needed.
